segments.name: Alcohol Beverages
segments.description: Produces and sells flavored malt beverages, hard seltzer, beer, hard cider, spirits RTDs and distilled spirits throughout the United States and selected international markets.
segments.evidence: The Company consists of one operating segment that produces and sells alcohol beverages under various brands.

revenueModel.text: Customers including off-premise retailers such as grocery stores, liquor stores and convenience stores purchase packaged beverages; on-premise retailers purchase kegs.
revenueModel.evidence: Sleek cans, standard cans and bottles are sold primarily for off-premise retailers, which include grocery stores, club stores, convenience stores, liquor stores, and other traditional and e-commerce retail outlets. Kegs are sold primarily for on-premise retailers, which include bars, restaurants, stadiums and other venues.
